title: Finland: 27.0 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €991,500 a year
markdown:
# Finland: 27.0 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €991,500 a year

> Closes 27.0 of 65.5 missing patients a year (41%) · €991,500 of €1.00M · €8,500 left: less than the next measure costs

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. By county it runs from 18 in Lapland to 36 in Vantaa and Kerava. Bringing every county below the national share up to it is about 66 patients a year; 50 of them are in the 7 counties that are below it by more than chance. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties (30.4%), 123.1 patients a year are missing. [^model] The material does not say how much of this is fewer operations and how much is less radiotherapy. [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 27.0% to 27.9% by 2028: 27.0 more patients a year (range 0.0–42.3), for €991,500 a year, about €36,790 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 41% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (65.5 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | County | Funded measures | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Lapland** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €174,000 | 4.9 |
| 2 | **Kymenlaakso** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €117,640 | 3.4 |
| 3 | **Satakunta** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists | €121,280 | 3.3 |
| 4 | **North Karelia** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €114,400 | 2.8 |
| 5 | **Southwest Finland** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €67,480 | 2.3 |
| 6 | **Kanta-Häme** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €64,840 | 2.2 |
| 7 | **South Karelia** | Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €97,500 | 2.0 |
| 8 | **South Savo** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €60,920 | 1.8 |
| 9 | **North Ostrobothnia** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €44,000 | 1.7 |
| 10 | **Kainuu** | A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital | €66,600 | 1.1 |
| 11 | **North Savo** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €27,640 | 1.0 |
| 12 | **Central Ostrobothnia** | Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital; Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment | €27,200 | 0.5 |
| 13 | **Vantaa and Kerava** | Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record | €8,000 | 0.0 |
| | **Total** | | **€991,500** | **27.0 (0.0–42.3)** |

Each county's own plan lists the owner, the first step and the measure for every action. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €17.4M a year; modelled to avoid 29.9 deaths a year (6.8–77.9). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 27.0% (2019–2023, measured) → 27.9% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

€8,500 is left. [^model] That is less than the cheapest measure that would still add something: fitness testing and training in Kainuu, at EUR 13,300 a year. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 2,303 deaths a year in Finland, and this plan is modelled to avoid 4.0 of them (range 0.0-12.7). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are a range, not a probability. The range runs from lowest to highest as all assumed effects move together, and no trial has measured them. [^model]
- The model adjusts only for residents' age, not stage, other illness, histology, smoking or recording completeness. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is only a secondary view. A check found that 0 of 3 measured outcomes moved with it beyond chance. [^model]

removed.sentence: Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers would add more, but it needs a national decision.
removed.reason: The clause 'would add more' is not supported by the material, which only lists screening as needing a national decision. The clause was cut, the rest was kept and the missing [^model] marker was added.

removed.sentence: Ranking measures by deaths avoided would also give a different plan. [^model]
removed.reason: The material never says that ranking by deaths avoided would produce a different plan. It only says some measures are counted under the deaths objective.

flagged.reason: The number had no source marker. The obvious source is the plan output, so [^model] was added.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not stage, other illness, histology, smoking or recording completeness.
flagged.reason: The county shares shown are raw measured figures. The age adjustment belongs to the model's expected-value comparison, so the sentence was reworded to say the model adjusts only for age.

flagged.sentence: This plan does not use the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock.
flagged.reason: The material does not say the plan excludes the clock. It calls the clock a secondary view, and the sentence was reworded to say that.

written_sections: What more money buys, and what it cannot
draft_markdown:
## The gap
Of 100 lung cancer patients in Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. By county it runs from 18 in Lapland to 36 in Vantaa and Kerava. Bringing every county below the national share up to it is about 66 patients a year; 50 of them are in the 7 counties that are below it by more than chance. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties (30.4%), 123.1 patients a year are missing. [^model] The material does not say how much of this is fewer operations and how much is less radiotherapy. [^model]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot
€8,500 is left. That is less than the cheapest measure that would still add something: fitness testing and training in Kainuu, at EUR 13,300 a year. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers would add more, but it needs a national decision. Ranking measures by deaths avoided would also give a different plan. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 2,303 deaths a year in Finland, and this plan is modelled to avoid 4.0 of them (range 0.0-12.7). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits
- Effects are a range, not a probability. The range runs from lowest to highest as all assumed effects move together, and no trial has measured them. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not stage, other illness, histology, smoking or recording completeness. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- This plan does not use the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock. A check found that 0 of 3 measured outcomes moved with it beyond chance. [^model]
